text.description_html:
Acorn AZC-202-4, Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel 4 Inch Cabinet Pull

The 4 Inch Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull is a modern pull that will add contemporary flair to any kitchen cabinet. It is 5-1/2 inches in length with a 4 inch center to center. Made out of stainless steel, the Deco Nouveau Stainless Steel 4 Cabinet Pull is available in polished and brushed finishes.

Also Available: 3 Inch Center to Center Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull and 3.5 Inch Center to Center Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull

Specifications for the Absolute Zero Collection Deco Nouveau Cabinet Pull Acorn AZC-202-4:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length (c.c hole spacing): 4"
  • Overall Length: 5.5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
